newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3939/3.3956 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3939/3.3956 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3925 to 3.3950 pounds bid and 3.3935 and 3.3970 pounds offered in the interbank market on Wednesday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3939 bid and 3.3956 offered compared to 3.3941 bid and 3.3958 offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.390865 buy and 3.397974 sell.
